name: Kelsie Rank
bio: Kelsie has moved around the past few years and has been able to see some amazing places, including living near the pacific coast (twice!) and the base of the Sawtooth mountains. These moves created a love of exploration, and now yearly excursions take place: by plane, train, or automobile! Kelsie graduated from Westminster College with a BA in Economics and a Minor in Film Studies, and she hopes to one day run a nonprofit. When Kelsie is not working, she enjoys hanging out with her dog Archie and exploring the mountains.

name: Linden Hughes
bio:
Linden was born and raised in beautiful Salt Lake City, UT. She loves to travel the world (Italy is her favorite), and has done so throughout her academic career. Linden holds the following degrees: BS Psychology, BS Sociology, Criminology Cert from the University of Utah; MA in Industrial/Organizational Psychology from George Mason University; and a MA in Forensic Psychology from the University of Denver. She has extensive experience in research-related pursuits and in tutoring in elementary up through undergraduate, and loves to share these passions with others.

Outside of academia, Linden has a weird fascination with cows, is likely the biggest fan of The Office (no exaggeration), knits like her life depends on it, is surprisingly good at pool and volleyball, and would sell both kidneys to see Eminem in concert. She loves being outside, trying new things, making an absurd amount of mini cheesecakes, and playing with her 15-lb loaf of a cat, Murphy.

name: Trevor Smith
bio: Trevor still says he is from San Clemente, CA despite living in Utah for the last five years. He recently graduated from the University of Utah with a Master of Arts in Communication, where he pursued research in critical media studies and artificial intelligence. Trevor has over five years of teaching experience at a university level and is passionate about learning. When not working, Trevor loves film, theater, music, and television of all kinds. He also loves cooking (and eating) and spending time with his cat Douglas.

name: Kevin Fober
bio: Our resident AP US History expert (via Zoom), Kevin originally hails from Wisconsin, where he earned a BA in Political Science from UW-Madison. From there he traveled to Illinois, and one MA in Political Science later from UI-Chicago, he continued to move West, eventually landing in Park City, UT as a much-loved APUSH teacher for many years. These days Kevin finds himself in Ohio, wishing for the days when he can travel again (he has been to 20 countries and 49 states) and maybe one day again dress up as Teddy Roosevelt when he covers the Progressive Era!

name: Kelsey Lee
bio:
Kelsey is a lawyer and professor whose passion for teaching has led her to tutor for the past decade. She graduated from American University with a BA in International Studies and then went on her to get her law degree at Temple University. Kelsey has worked as an attorney with non-profit organizations all over the world and taught graduate-level courses at Kean University. She now lives in beautiful Ireland, working on her Phd in Law at Trinity College, Dublin.

Wherever her law career has taken her, Kelsey just can’t give up the satisfaction that comes helping students accomplish their goals. She enjoys working with SAT/ACT students, as well as assisting with essays and college entrance applications. It’s also great when she can combine her love of tutoring and the law, helping students prep for the LSAT, law classes, and the Bar Exam.

In her spare time, Kelsey loves hiking the gorgeous Irish countryside with her family dog Bruno.
